name: hisar
title: Hisar
description: Search Hisar, copy and paste passwords, usernames and one-time codes, open and share items, generate passwords and lock Hisar.
author: tryhisar

commands.name: search-hisar
commands.title: Search Hisar
commands.subtitle: Hisar
commands.description: Find an item, then copy or paste its password, username or one-time code, open it in Hisar or share it.

commands.name: my-vaults
commands.title: My Vaults
commands.subtitle: Hisar
commands.description: Browse your vaults, then the items in one.

commands.name: one-time-codes
commands.title: One-Time Codes
commands.subtitle: Hisar
commands.description: Show live one-time codes, then copy or paste one.

commands.name: generate-password
commands.title: Generate Password
commands.subtitle: Hisar
commands.description: Copy a new password from Hisar's generator: 24 characters with digits and symbols.

commands.name: generate-password-form
commands.title: Generate Password with Options
commands.subtitle: Hisar
commands.description: Choose the length, digits and symbols of a new password, then copy or paste it.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: What Return does on an item. An item without that value does the next action it has.

preferences.name: secondaryAction
preferences.title: Secondary Action
preferences.description: What ⌘ Return does on an item. An item without that value does the next action it has.

preferences.name: closeWindowAfterCopying
preferences.title: Copying
preferences.label: Close Raycast after copying
preferences.description: Close Raycast after copying a password, username, one-time code or share link; otherwise a toast says it was copied.

preferences.name: socketPath
preferences.title: Socket
preferences.description: Hisar's command-line socket. Change it only when Hisar runs with HISAR_CLI_SOCKET.
